dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of solid low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters localized on the posterior dorsal and lower lateral regions, lacking internal gradients or centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal region form an irregular trapezoidal configuration relative to the longitudinal axis of the body.
